'''Necrotic sugar candy''' was a type of confection available on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]], home of the [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The candies came in the shapes of [[Bone/Legends|skulls]] of various species, including [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]], [[Human/Legends|Human]], Swokes Swokes, and [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]].<ref name="S14">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']], Chapter 14</ref>
